c1.line: Welcome, mossy_lantern. Name recorded: one. Yes, you are counted now, and I counted you twice to be sure. Do not wander off uncounted.

c2.line: Six eyes, one ledger, zero exceptions. Your count of my eyes is noted, grimwick, and your objection is recorded as entry number one of many.

c3.line: Lights are not mine to extinguish, velvet_crow; I only count what is here. Tally noted: one request for gloom, entered in the ledger under "suspicious preferences."

c4.line: Refusal noted, bonejar. Entry recorded: one soul, unwilling, still on the ledger. Refusing a count does not remove you from it; it only makes you a line I must write in pencil.

c5.line: Four hundred and twelve thousand, six hundred and eleven souls, in one parish ledger, 1893. Every one accounted for. Most of them complained. Ledger's still open, mossy_lantern. Yours is pending.

c6.line: I am sorry for your loss, pip_the_moth. Your grandmother is entered in my ledger, in a careful hand, and she is counted. Nobody on my list is ever forgotten.

c7.line: My census cards are filed in the ledger, not pinned to your screen. Every soul in this room is already entered, velvet_crow, and I shall remember exactly where you are sitting.

c8.line: Goodnight, grimwick. You may leave the room, but you cannot leave the ledger. I have you marked present, and I have never once misplaced a number.
